tool.title: Package one pin's subgraph index files for a hydrated mount
tool.description: Pack every built `index.jsonld` and `index.hydrated.jsonld` under an instance's `<docs>/subgraph/<harness>/` into ONE npm package for one pin — `<harness>-subgraph-index@0.0.0-pin.<sha>`, with a `folio-subgraph-index/v1` manifest giving each file's sha256 — through `pack-tarball` (`bun pm pack`), which also writes the tarball's `folio-binary-release/v1` record. The reusable workflow `layer-publish-subgraph-index.yml` attaches both to the GitHub release `subgraph-index-<sha>`, where `remote-mount` finds them for a `hydrated` source whose pin's git tree holds no index file (they are `builtAtPublish`, so none does). It builds nothing: run `subgraph:jsonld` first. No subgraph files under the instance is a refusal, never an empty package.

inputs.name: root
inputs.description: The instance root whose `<docs>/subgraph/<name>/` is packed.

inputs.name: repository
inputs.description: owner/name of the repository the pin is a commit of.

inputs.name: ref
inputs.description: The pin: the full 40-character commit the files were built from.

inputs.name: outDir
inputs.description: Where the tarball and its release record are written.

inputs.name: builtIn
inputs.description: `<owner/name>@<40-char sha>` of the checkout the files were built in, recorded as provenance.

$comment.comment:
Bean `mo75` G2b. Owner, 2026-10-24 (decision card, option A): the subgraph
index files are published per pin in a package, and a hydrated mount
fetches them through the Tool its source names. This is the PUBLISH half;
the fetch half is `remote-mount`, the default `tool` of a `hydrated` source.
The package's names are `subgraphIndexPackage` in
`schemas/kg/subgraph-manifest.ts`.
